hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r file_path; case "$file_path" in *.js|*.ts|*.jsx|*.tsx|*.json|*.jsonc|*.css|*.graphql) node bin/howells-oxfmt.mjs --write "$file_path" ;; esac; }
git diff --name-only --diff-filter=d HEAD | grep -E '\.(js|ts|jsx|tsx|json|jsonc|css|graphql)$' | while IFS= read -r file_path; do node bin/howells-oxfmt.mjs --write "$file_path"; done
